name: Absinthe Gallery
description: Full-screen portrait gallery where each slide is a square card that flips between a photo with biography and a photo with a quote, with thumbnail strip, arrows, swipe and keyboard navigation.
contents: Heading with title and script accent word
Horizontal slider of portrait cards with front biography and back quote
Bottom navigation with thumbnail strip, previous and next buttons, signature and page counter
behavior: Slides move horizontally with eased transform
Clicking a card crossfades between front and back faces
Arrow keys change slide and space flips all cards
Broken images fall back to initials
editableByProps: Heading text, all card text, quotes, images and signatures
Background, text, accent, shade and card colors, optional image tint, grayscale, corner radius

needsCodeEdit.where: ease-[cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.2,1)] class on the slider div
onKey function inside the first useEffect
onEnd function with the 50 pixel check

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the Google Fonts families loaded
needsCodeEdit.where: link stylesheet href at the top of the returned fragment

fixed: Listens for arrow keys and space on window while mounted, space is prevented from scrolling, removed on unmount
Loads Google Fonts through link tags for the default font props
Progress line and bottom navigation are position fixed to the viewport
Root is a full-screen section, 100dvh by 100vw, with hidden overflow
backQuote is rendered as HTML, supports b and strong tags
